newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine mill buys 10,000 tonnes U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine mill buys 10,000 tonnes U.S. wheat.

text.p: A Philippine mill bought 10,000 tonnes of U.S. dark northern spring wheat at around $189 per tonne FOB for April shipment, Manila grains traders said on Thursday.
They said the Philippine firm plans to buy another 15,000 tonnes of wheat for April shipment.

"The company bought 5,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a 13.5 percent protein content and another 5,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a 14 percent protein content Wednesday night," said a senior Manila trader.
Traders said the wheat order was made through U.S.-based trading firm Continental Grains.
